description: This file contains the ApiTokenHelper class which provides static methods to generate JWT tokens for different user roles ('admin' and 'normal user') used within functional tests of the web API.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to create JWT tokens with specific roles for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user with the role 'Administrators'.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with no specific roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Private method that creates a JWT token with specified username and roles.
